pages.title: Quantum Field Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Quantum Field Theory$()$(br2)Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

$(thing)Insight$(): 50$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Calculus, Abstract Algebra, High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Wave Packet.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A free scalar field is a collection of independent harmonic oscillators, one for every wave vector k. Each oscillator has a lowering operator that destroys a particle and a raising operator that creates one, multiplying a plane wave e^(∓ik·x) of the field's 4-momentum. Write the field operator as an integral over all momenta with the relativistically normalised measure.
